digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding lifecycle config ownership
propositions: binding_lifecycle.py contains two ambient config/environment reads (RECONCILER_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE via _env_int shim and raw os.environ.get) that remain in the LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS whitelist after RP-04 S7.3.a

resolve_absent_retire_grace() is already exposed as a public owned accessor on rebar.config facade with identical semantics to the local _env_int shim, following the established pattern used by fetcher.py and applier.py
The _env_int helper in binding_lifecycle.py is dead code after moving its sole caller (note_absent absence-retire grace read) to use the owned resolve_absent_retire_grace() accessor
Removing both binding_lifecycle.py rows from LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS will leave the config-ownership whitelist empty, completing the RP-04 drain epic

The _DEFAULT_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE constant must be retained because binding_store.py aliases it at import time and tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_no_resurrection_after_confirmed_delete_3b5f.py depends on it
